name: Charles Dyer
keyEvent: Honorably discharged September 25, 1778 after service in the 12th Virginia Regiment at Fort Randolph.
evidenceSummary: Discharged at Fort Randolph [at Point Pleasant, now WV] on September 25, 1778
Served as a soldier in Captain William McKee's company of the 12th Virginia Regiment
The discharge says his enlistment time had fully expired and that he had served upwards of two years
A later county settlement record dated December 19, 1854 places a Charles Dyer settlement in the Virginia continental line pay records
The 1855 county affidavit names Jonathan Dyer among the heirs and identifies Charles Dyer as the Revolutionary War pension applicant
